9.8.2. qnav.output.formats

class qnav.output.formats.FileFormat(match_id: str, file_ext: str)[source]

Defines the fields for each supported file format. Included as a simpler way to represent the SaveFormat enum class.

class qnav.output.formats.SaveFormat(value, names=<not given>, *values, module=None, qualname=None, type=None, start=1, boundary=None)[source]

A collection of the supported file formats for results table. Controllable flags for selecting the use of the supported file formats when exporting data. A useful way to efficiently export data in multiple formats, without employing multiple functions.

qnav.output.formats.save_as_csv(file_path: Path, results: ResultsTable, down_sample: int = 1)[source]

Exports the given results table as a CSV file.

Parameters:

  • file_path (pathlib.Path) – The file path to save the CSV data to.

  • results (ResultsTable) – The results to convert to CSV.

  • down_sample (int) – Optional down-sampling factor to apply.

qnav.output.formats.save_as_csv_comp(file_path: Path, results: ResultsTable, down_sample: int = 1)[source]

Exports the given results table as a compressed CSV file.

Parameters:

  • file_path (pathlib.Path) – The file path to save the compressed CSV data to.

  • results (ResultsTable) – The results to convert to compressed CSV.

  • down_sample (int) – Optional down-sampling factor to apply.

qnav.output.formats.save_as_numpy(file_path: Path, results: ResultsTable, down_sample: int = 1)[source]

Exports the given results table as a numpy data file.

Parameters:

  • file_path (pathlib.Path) – The file path to save the numpy data to.

  • results (ResultsTable) – The results to convert to numpy save file.

  • down_sample (int) – Optional down-sampling factor to apply.

qnav.output.formats.save_as_numpy_comp(file_path: Path, results: ResultsTable, down_sample: int = 1)[source]

Exports the given results table as a compressed numpy data file.

Parameters:

  • file_path (pathlib.Path) – The file path to save the compressed numpy data to.

  • results (ResultsTable) – The results to convert to compressed numpy save file.

  • down_sample (int) – Optional down-sampling factor to apply.

qnav.output.formats.save_as_binary(file_path: Path, results: ResultsTable, down_sample: int = 1)[source]

Exports the given results table as a compressed numpy data file.

Parameters:

  • file_path (pathlib.Path) – The file path to save the compressed numpy data to.

  • results (ResultsTable) – The results to convert to compressed numpy save file.

  • down_sample (int) – Optional down-sampling factor to apply.

qnav.output.formats.save_as_matlab(file_path: Path, results: ResultsTable, down_sample: int = 1)[source]

Exports the given results table as a (non-compressed) MATLAB data file.

Parameters:

  • file_path (pathlib.Path) – The file path to save the MATLAB data to.

  • results (ResultsTable) – The results to convert to MATLAB file.

  • down_sample (int) – Optional down-sampling factor to apply.

qnav.output.formats.save_as_matlab_comp(file_path: Path, results: ResultsTable, down_sample: int = 1)[source]

Exports the given results table as a MATLAB data file (with compression).

Parameters:

  • file_path (pathlib.Path) – The file path to save the MATLAB data to.

  • results (ResultsTable) – The results to convert to MATLAB file.

  • down_sample (int) – Optional down-sampling factor to apply.

qnav.output.formats.save_as(file_dir: Path, file_name: str, results: ResultsTable, down_sample: int = 1, *formats: SaveFormat)[source]

Saves the given results as one or format types.

Parameters:

  • file_dir (pathlib.Path) – The location to write results to.

  • file_name (str) – The filename prefix to use.

  • results (ResultsTable) – The results to convert and write.

  • down_sample (int) – Optional down-sampling factor to apply.

  • formats (SaveFormat) – The output formats to use.
